class.name: BoneClothSimulator3D
class.brief_description: A [SkeletonModifier3D] that sways bone chains such as hair, skirts and capes.
class.description: Each chain runs from its root bone, which follows the pose, down to its end bone, and can branch from a bone of an earlier chain. The values apply to every chain, so parts that need others take a separate node. [BoneClothCollision3D] children keep the chains out of the body. For a skinned mesh with no bones along the cloth, set [member mesh_instance] instead of chains. Start from a preset in the node's toolbar menu and tune [member stiffness/value] and [member drag/value]. The menu's [b]Show[/b] items draw the radius, the limits and the backstop. Lengths and speeds are in meters at the model's size, so a centimeter rig takes the same values as a meter rig. [b]Note:[/b] Most methods in this class take an [code]index[/code] parameter. This parameter specifies which chain to use (e.g. [code]chains/<index>/root_bone_name[/code]), except in the sync bone methods, where it specifies which sync bone to use (e.g. [code]sync/bones/<index>/bone_name[/code]), and in the mesh fixed bone methods, where it specifies which fixed bone to use (e.g. [code]mesh_fixed_bones/<index>[/code]).

method.name: apply_preset
method.description: Copies the values of [param preset] to this node, except those that [BoneClothPreset] leaves out.

method.name: are_all_child_collisions_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if all child [BoneClothCollision3D]s collide with the chain, except those in its exclude collision list.

method.name: clear_collisions
method.description: Clears the chain's collision list. Works only while [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: clear_exclude_collisions
method.description: Clears the chain's exclude collision list. Works only while [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: get_collision_count
method.description: Returns the number of collisions in the chain's collision list.

method.name: get_collision_path
method.description: Returns the node path of the [BoneClothCollision3D] at [param collision] in the chain's collision list.

method.name: get_end_bone
method.description: Returns the end bone index of the chain.

method.name: get_end_bone_direction
method.description: Returns the tail direction of the chain's end bone.

method.name: get_end_bone_length
method.description: Returns the tail length of the chain's end bone.

method.name: get_end_bone_name
method.description: Returns the end bone name of the chain.

method.name: get_exclude_collision_count
method.description: Returns the number of collisions in the chain's exclude collision list.

method.name: get_exclude_collision_path
method.description: Returns the node path of the [BoneClothCollision3D] at [param collision] in the chain's exclude collision list.

method.name: get_mesh_fixed_bone
method.description: Returns the bone name of the fixed bone.

method.name: get_root_bone
method.description: Returns the root bone index of the chain.

method.name: get_root_bone_name
method.description: Returns the root bone name of the chain.

method.name: get_sync_bone
method.description: Returns the bone index of the sync bone.

method.name: get_sync_bone_direction
method.description: Returns which way the chains follow the sync bone's swing along [param axis].

method.name: get_sync_bone_falloff_amount
method.description: Returns how much less the joints past the outer radius follow the sync bone.

method.name: get_sync_bone_falloff_inner
method.description: Returns the distance from the sync bone, in meters, within which joints follow it fully.

method.name: get_sync_bone_falloff_outer
method.description: Returns the distance from the sync bone, in meters, past which joints follow it least.

method.name: get_sync_bone_name
method.description: Returns the bone name of the sync bone.

method.name: is_end_bone_extended
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the chain's end bone is extended to have a tail.

method.name: make_preset
method.description: Returns a new [BoneClothPreset] with this node's values.

method.name: reset
method.description: Resets the chains to the current pose, at rest. Call it when the pose jumps, such as after [method AnimationPlayer.play] without blending, and after turning [member SkeletonModifier3D.active] back on.

method.name: set_collision_count
method.description: Sets the number of collisions in the chain's collision list. Works only while [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: set_collision_path
method.description: Sets the node path of the [BoneClothCollision3D] at [param collision] in the chain's collision list. The node must be a child of this node. Works only while [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: set_enable_all_child_collisions
method.description: If [param enabled] is [code]true[/code], all child [BoneClothCollision3D]s collide with the chain, except those in its exclude collision list ([method set_exclude_collision_path]). If [param enabled] is [code]false[/code], only the collisions in its collision list ([method set_collision_path]) collide with the chain.

method.name: set_end_bone
method.description: Sets the end bone index of the chain. [code]-1[/code] is no bone.

method.name: set_end_bone_direction
method.description: Sets the tail direction of the chain's end bone, in the end bone's own axes.

method.name: set_end_bone_length
method.description: Sets the tail length of the chain's end bone, in meters.

method.name: set_end_bone_name
method.description: Sets the end bone name of the chain. The end bone must be the root bone or below it.

method.name: set_exclude_collision_count
method.description: Sets the number of collisions in the chain's exclude collision list. Works only while [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: set_exclude_collision_path
method.description: Sets the node path of the [BoneClothCollision3D] at [param collision] in the chain's exclude collision list. The node must be a child of this node. Works only while [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: set_extend_end_bone
method.description: If [param enabled] is [code]true[/code], the chain's end bone gets a tail so that it can sway too. [b]Note:[/b] Unlike [SpringBoneSimulator3D], the end bone is extended by default, with a length of [code]0.1[/code].

method.name: set_mesh_fixed_bone
method.description: Sets the bone name of the fixed bone, such as the hips. See [member mesh_fixed_bone_count].

method.name: set_root_bone
method.description: Sets the root bone index of the chain. [code]-1[/code] is no bone.

method.name: set_root_bone_name
method.description: Sets the root bone name of the chain. The root bone follows the pose, unless [member root_spring_stiffness] is above [code]0.0[/code].

method.name: set_sync_bone
method.description: Sets the bone index of the sync bone. [code]-1[/code] is no bone.

method.name: set_sync_bone_direction
method.description: Sets which way the chains follow the sync bone's swing along one skeleton axis. On a character facing +Z, [constant SYNC_DIRECTION_POSITIVE] on Z lets a skirt follow a thigh forward but not back.

method.name: set_sync_bone_falloff_amount
method.description: Sets how much less the joints past [method set_sync_bone_falloff_outer] follow the sync bone, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. At [code]1.0[/code], they do not follow it.

method.name: set_sync_bone_falloff_inner
method.description: Sets the distance from the sync bone, in meters, within which joints follow it fully. See [method set_sync_bone_falloff_outer].

method.name: set_sync_bone_falloff_outer
method.description: Sets the distance from the sync bone, in meters, past which joints follow it least. Lets the hem of a long skirt hang while its waist follows the thigh. [code]0.0[/code] disables the falloff.

method.name: set_sync_bone_name
method.description: Sets the bone name of the sync bone, such as a thigh inside a skirt. See [member sync/bone_count]. An empty name is no bone.

members.member: A [Node3D] the character rides, such as a vehicle or a moving platform. The cloth leaves out the anchor's movement and rotation, and reacts only to the character's own moves on it. An empty path disables it.
How much the cloth still reacts to the [member anchor]'s movement and rotation, from [code]0.0[/code] (not at all) to [code]1.0[/code] (as if there were no anchor).
The index of [member backstop/bone_name]. [code]-1[/code] is no bone.

The bone at the center of the backstop, such as the head for bangs. A wall behind each joint's pose keeps it from moving toward this center, so bangs stay out of the head without a collision. An empty name disables it.
Scales [member backstop/distance] from the roots ([code]0.0[/code]) to the tips ([code]1.0[/code]).
How far, in meters, each joint can move from its pose toward the center of the backstop. [code]0.0[/code] puts the wall at the pose.
The position offset of the backstop's center from [member backstop/bone_name], along the bone's axes. For bangs, put the center in the middle of the head.
The radius, in meters, of the wall behind each joint. The default [code]10.0[/code] is almost flat, and smaller values curve it. [code]0.0[/code] disables the backstop.
Stops the simulation while this node's bones are outside the camera view. Saves the cost of characters the camera does not see. [constant CAMERA_CULLING_OFF] disables it.
How far the chains swing outward while the character turns, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. A skirt flares in a spin and long hair fans out. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
The number of chains.
How firmly joints grip a collision they touch, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]0.5[/code]. A skirt clings to the thighs instead of slipping off them. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
How steady the part near the roots stays while the character moves, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Keeps a skirt's waist steady while its hem swings. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.

Stops the simulation while the camera is farther than this from the skeleton, in meters, and starts it again from the animation when it comes back. Saves the cost of crowds and distant characters. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.

Share of [member distance_culling], from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code], over which the motion fades into the animation before it stops. Keeps hair and skirts from snapping still at the cut. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
Scales [member drag/value] from the roots ([code]0.0[/code]) to the tips ([code]1.0[/code]).

How soon the swaying dies out after the character stops, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Recommended values are between [code]0.1[/code] and [code]0.3[/code]; higher values do not settle sooner.
Scales [member gravity/value] from the roots ([code]0.0[/code]) to the tips ([code]1.0[/code]).
The direction of gravity, in world space. It cannot be zero.

How much weaker gravity is while the chains hang as in the rest pose, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Hair keeps its shape while the head is upright and falls when the character bends over. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
The gravity, in meters per second squared. [code]9.8[/code] is the earth's gravity. [code]0.0[/code] disables it. [b]Note:[/b] Unlike [SpringBoneSimulator3D], this is an acceleration, not a velocity.
How much the cloth reacts to the character's movement and rotation, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Lower it if the cloth reacts too much.

Softens the cloth's reaction to the character's sudden starts and stops, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Keeps hair and skirts from jolting when a run starts or ends. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
The maximum speed of each joint, in meters per second. Keeps the tips of long hair from swinging out too far, and [code]3.0[/code] suits it. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
Scales [member limit_angle/value], or [member limit_angle/lower] and [member limit_angle/upper], from the roots ([code]0.0[/code]) to the tips ([code]1.0[/code]).
How far each bone can swing the negative way around the parent bone's axes, in radians, from [code]-PI[/code] to [code]0.0[/code]. Near [code]0.0[/code], hair swings back but not into the face.
The shape of the swing limit: a cone, or a range around each axis of the parent bone. Ranges make hinges and one-way bends, such as an earring or a tail. The axis along the bone is ignored.
How firmly the limit holds, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Lower values let long hair slide over a shoulder instead of jumping through it. [code]0.66[/code] suits long hair.
How far each bone can swing the positive way around the parent bone's axes, in radians, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]PI[/code]. An axis with both ends at [code]0.0[/code] is locked.
The maximum angle each bone can swing from the pose, in radians. Recommended values are between [code]0.5[/code] (30 degrees) and [code]1.3[/code] (75 degrees). [code]0.0[/code] disables it.

How strongly linked chains keep the bends between them as in the pose, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Keeps a skirt round when a leg pushes one of its chains. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
Links neighboring chains so that a collision cannot pass between them. A branch that starts below its trunk's root is not linked.
Scales [member link_spacing/value] from the roots ([code]0.0[/code]) to the tips ([code]1.0[/code]). For long hair, keep it at [code]0.0[/code] until past the middle.
How strongly linked chains keep apart, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Keeps gaps between strands of long hair. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
If [code]true[/code], linked chains part around a collision, as long hair parts over a shoulder. Leave it [code]false[/code] for skirts and capes.

How strongly the links hold neighboring chains together, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Recommended values are between [code]0.0[/code] and [code]0.5[/code]. At [code]0.0[/code], the links only collide.

How far linked chains can move apart, as a multiple of their distance in the rest pose. [code]1.3[/code] lets a skirt flare in a spin but keeps it from stretching when a leg pushes it. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.

The speed of the roots, in meters per second, above which the chains move with them instead of swaying. Keeps long hair from flapping with every stride of a run, and [code]3.0[/code] suits it. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
Like [member local_movement_speed_limit], for rotation, in radians per second. [code]6.283[/code] (360 degrees) suits long hair. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
Scales [member max_distance/value] from the roots ([code]0.0[/code]) to the tips ([code]1.0[/code]).
How far, in meters, each joint can move from its pose. Keeps chains from flying off in a dash or a sudden stop. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
The most simulation steps one frame may run, from [code]1[/code] up. A slow frame runs this many and drops the rest of its time, so one hitch does not slow the next frames. Lower it to cap the cost.
The number of fixed bones. Vertices weighted mostly to these bones, such as the hips and the spine for a skirt's waistband, follow the pose instead of swaying. At least one is needed.

A skinned [MeshInstance3D] to sway as cloth, such as a skirt skinned to the legs with no bones along it. The node simulates points spread over its surface and draws the mesh from them in place of the original, whose blend shapes and instance shader parameters it keeps following. An empty path sways the chains instead.
The distance between the simulated points on the mesh's surface. Smaller values follow folds more closely and cost more. [code]0.05[/code] suits a knee-length skirt.
How firmly [member max_distance/value] and the backstop hold, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Lower values let a joint pass the limit and come back over the next steps.
The character speed, in meters per second, above which the cloth stops reacting to faster movement.
Scales [member radius/value] from the roots ([code]0.0[/code]) to the tips ([code]1.0[/code]).

If [code]true[/code], cloth that touches a collision in the rest pose stays as modeled, such as a skirt's waist against the thighs. Set it to [code]false[/code] for long hair that hangs through the shoulders in the rest pose.
The radius of each joint against the collisions, in meters.
How far the root bone can move forward along its bone, in meters, less as it moves to the side. Keeps a breast from stretching forward when the character stops.
How far the root bone can move from the pose, in meters.
How much the root spring's strength wavers over time, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code], differently in each chain. Keeps two breasts from bouncing in step. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
Lets the root bone sway too, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code], for a part that moves as a lump, such as a breast. Lower values bounce longer. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
The character rotation speed, in radians per second, above which the cloth stops reacting to faster turns.

How much of its root's motion in the animation each chain takes at once, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Keeps hair from trailing far behind a quick head turn. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
The acceleration of a chain's first bone, in meters per second squared, above which the chain moves with its root at once. Catches sudden jerks, not smooth motion. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
How long, in seconds, the motion fades in from the animation after the simulation starts or resets. Hides the jolt when a character appears while running or turning. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
Scales [member stiffness/value] from the roots ([code]0.0[/code]) to the tips ([code]1.0[/code]).

How strongly the chains return to the pose, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Higher values swing less. Recommended values are between [code]0.05[/code] and [code]0.2[/code], not those of [SpringBoneSimulator3D].

Keeps the pull of [member stiffness/value] from building speed, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. The chains return to the pose more slowly, without swinging past it. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.

The number of sync bones, such as both thighs for a skirt or a long coat. The chains in the way of a bone's swing move with it as if hung from it, so the legs do not pass through the cloth. [code]0[/code] disables it.

How far the chains turn with the sync bones, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. At lower values their roots still move with the bones, and the chains lift less. [code]0.5[/code] suits a skirt.
A turn of the character larger than this in one frame, in radians, is a teleport, such as a snap to a new facing. [member teleport_mode] handles it. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
A move of the character farther than this in one frame, in meters, is a teleport, such as a respawn. [member teleport_mode] handles it. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
What the cloth does after a teleport, see [member teleport_distance] and [member teleport_angle].

How close a joint may come to its chain's root, as a share of their distance in the pose, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Keeps tips from folding back toward the root on violent moves. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
How many simulation steps run each second, from [code]30[/code] up. More steps follow fast moves more closely and cost more time. The cloth hangs and swings about the same at any value.
How fast this simulator's chains waver in the wind, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]2.0[/code], multiplied by [member BoneClothWind3D.frequency].
Scales [member wind_influence/value] from the roots ([code]0.0[/code]) to the tips ([code]1.0[/code]). Lower its start to keep the waist of a skirt or the roots of bangs steady.
How hard the wind pushes this simulator's chains, from [code]0.0[/code] up, as a multiple of [member BoneClothWind3D.strength]. Lower it for heavy cloth such as a coat. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
How closely neighboring chains move together in the wind. [code]1.0[/code] moves them as one, [code]0.0[/code] moves them separately.
How much this simulator's chains waver in the wind, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]2.0[/code], multiplied by [member BoneClothWind3D.turbulence].

constants.constant: Each chain is linked to the next one in the list, for a cape or a skirt open at the front.
The chains are linked all around, in their order around the direction they hang, whatever their list order. For a skirt all around.
The simulation runs whether its bones are on screen or not.
Off screen the simulation stops, and starts again from the animation when the bones come back into view.
Off screen the simulation stops, and carries on where it stopped when the bones come back into view.
Each bone swings within a cone of [member limit_angle/value] around its pose.
Each bone swings within [member limit_angle/lower] and [member limit_angle/upper] around the axes of its parent bone.
The cloth ignores the teleport's motion and keeps swinging as before it.
The cloth starts again from the animation, as after [method reset].
The chains follow the sync bone's swing along the axis both ways.
The chains follow the swing only toward the positive side of the axis.
The chains follow the swing only toward the negative side of the axis.
The chains do not follow the swing along the axis.
